name: Kingyobachi no Naka no Shoujo
source:
It was a rural village, where each year a special festival was held.
The festival was a ritual of deflowering, and this year, petite loli Mai was chosen.
Her tiny body was the delight of many festivities.
Her sempai Kosaya also guided her in girl-girl pleasures. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE087609.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
那是一个乡村，村里每年都会举行特殊祭典。
祭典的仪式是破处，而今年被选中的是娇小的萝莉舞。
她娇小的身体成为众多庆典活动的乐趣。
她的前辈小沙也会引导她体验女性之间的欢愉。
